layers.title: Current provincial-level units
layers.description: The 34 provincial-level administrative units effective from 1 July 2025, dissolved from the bundled commune layer so that parent and child boundaries share one source.

source.name: Vietnamese Provinces Database
source.upstream: Viet Nam Administrative Units Reference Map

layers.title: Current commune-level units
layers.description: The 3,321 commune-level units in the 25 July 2026 catalogue snapshot, carrying validity, vintage, source and geometry-accuracy columns.

source.name: Vietnamese Provinces Database
source.upstream: Viet Nam Administrative Units Reference Map

layers.title: Pre-reform provincial-level units
layers.description: The 63 provincial-level units as they stood before the July 2025 reform, retained for data collected under that geography.

layers.title: Current provincial lookup table
layers.description: Codes, ISO codes, Vietnamese and English names, unit type and matching aliases for the current 34 units. Carries no geometry, so name lookups work without 'sf'.

source.name: Decision 19/2025/QD-TTg names and codes, compiled by vnmap
source.license: Factual metadata; legal texts are linked, not redistributed

layers.title: Pre-reform provincial lookup table
layers.description: Codes, ISO 3166-2 codes, names, unit type and matching aliases for the 63 pre-reform units.

source.name: Pre-2025 official names and codes, compiled by vnmap
source.license: Factual metadata; legal texts are linked, not redistributed

layers.title: Socio-economic region assignments
layers.description: The six-region scheme for both geographies. Assignments for the 63 units are official; those for the 34 current units are derived by placing each 2025 unit in the region holding the largest share of its 2024 population.
layers.administrative_basis: Six-region scheme of the General Statistics Office of Viet Nam

source.name: General Statistics Office of Viet Nam

layers.title: Transport facilities and trunk network
layers.description: Aerodrome, port and border-control entities together with nationwide trunk-network segments. Community mapping, not an official transport register.

layers.title: Industrial parks and zones
layers.description: Industrial parks, export processing zones, high-tech parks and industrial clusters read from OpenStreetMap and audited against the Foreign Investment Agency baseline of 16 November 2025.
layers.geometry_accuracy: community mapping; coverage gaps are explicit

source.name: OpenStreetMap
source.upstream: Baseline counts: Foreign Investment Agency, Ministry of Finance, 2025-11-16

layers.title: Economic and policy zones
layers.description: An evidence-graded catalogue of coastal economic zones, border-gate economic zones, export processing zones and high-tech parks. Only rows joining the instrument table to a verified official establishment URL are labelled established.
layers.geometry_vintage: Representative points derived from the bundled pre-2025 province geometry
layers.geometry_accuracy: representative points only; not boundaries or site locations

source.name: Government legal-document portal of Viet Nam
source.license: Factual metadata; legal texts are linked, not redistributed

layers.title: Provincial statistics 2024, current geography
layers.description: Area, average population, density and GRDP per capita for the 34 current units, aggregated from the 63-unit geography in which the statistics were published.

source.name: General Statistics Office of Viet Nam, PX-Web

layers.title: Provincial statistics 2024, pre-reform geography
layers.description: The same indicators as published, on the 63-unit geography, before any aggregation.

source.name: General Statistics Office of Viet Nam, PX-Web
